text: Cladding and roofing: sandwich panels with a coated steel or aluminium skin suitable for C5 (Class RC5 or PVDF-coated, more than 15 years); fixings in stainless steel A4; roof and wall panels of the turbine hall and other buildings with hazardous gas potential shall have blow-out or vent area where required by the explosion protection document (HS-RPT-0005).
